Hallmark Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Cisco Systems Inc (CSCO) by 3.16% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hallmark Capital Management Inc sold 16,735 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.63% with the market. The institutional investor held 513,287 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $22.02M, down from 530,022 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hallmark Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Cisco Systems Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $206.97 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.16% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $44.01. About 18.34M shares traded. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) has risen 37.60% since June 14, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 25.03% the S&P500.
